baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 2, 3, 6, and 7 joins deliberate aftermath-reading, the gathered recitation, the faculty of understanding, and closure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tadabbur is a procedure for relating the Quran's gathered units and following what they entail to their ends. The hearts should perform that integration, while their locks stop the inferential chain before it reaches consequence.

activation_trace.role: Looking through an affair to what it becomes supplies the forward consequence-tracing operation of the model.
Gathering parts supplies an assembled field whose units must be held together rather than received in isolation.
Reading and recitation supply the actual textual intake on which consequence-tracing operates.
The heart as understanding and inward cognition supplies the faculty expected to integrate the recitation.
Locking, rigidity, and closure supply the blockage that interrupts movement from words to consequences.

changed_reading.before: A general rebuke for not thinking about scripture.
changed_reading.after: A demand to connect the gathered recitation through its downstream consequences, with failure located in the faculty that should sustain those links.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots at words 2 and 6 both permit spatial reversal: attending to what is behind and turning a thing from face to face, while the same heart root also names an inner core.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reader turns the collected discourse over, looks behind its presented face, and keeps reversing relations until its core becomes available. A lock freezes that motion and leaves the surface unturned.

activation_trace.role: Behindness supplies the spatial invitation to inspect what lies beyond the text's immediately presented face.
Collection supplies the whole object whose internal relations can be turned and compared.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies the repeated reversal that exposes alternative relations.
The pure inner core supplies the depth toward which the turning operation is directed.
Closure and hardening supply the arrested state in which neither object nor reader can be reoriented.

changed_reading.before: Reflection means holding the verse before the mind.
changed_reading.after: Reflection means actively turning the collected discourse, inspecting its reverse side, and penetrating from presented surface toward core.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The indefinite plural hearts at word 6 and the attached possessive on the plural locks at word 7 assign closure to the hearts rather than opacity to the Quran.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Quran remains available for recitation, but each heart can carry its own closure. The diagnosis is therefore distributed and reader-specific: common exposure can meet different lock configurations.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies a shared object that can reach multiple hearers without guaranteeing equal uptake.
Hearts as loci of understanding supply the plural recipients to which the impediment belongs.
Locks and rigidity supply localized closures owned by those recipients.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is difficult or unavailable to comprehension.
changed_reading.after: The Quran is exposed in common, while the verse asks which heart-specific closures prevent different readers from receiving its relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier command to move through the earth, direct sight or insight, and inspect prior peoples' end gives the focus verb an enacted method. Tadabbur now includes testing the Quran's gathered claims against visible historical trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Looking to an affair's end supplies the focus operation that the contextual sequence makes observable.
Collection supplies the set of claims and examples whose relations can be checked across cases.
Movement and passage supply bodily traversal as the first stage of the investigative procedure.
Directed sight or insight supplies deliberate observation rather than passive encounter.
The last state and consequence supply the historical endpoint that observation is commanded to recover.

structural_cues: 47:10 orders travel, then looking, then asks how the outcome of earlier peoples was; its sequence behaves like a procedure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement, directed observation, and an outcome; I infer the arrow from that sequence to a method for tadabbur. A live alternative is that 47:10 is only an example of reflection, not its operational definition.

changed_reading.before: Tadabbur privately infers consequences from words.
changed_reading.after: Tadabbur also walks the Quran's claims through observable histories and compares stated patterns with realized ends.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 47:16 people acoustically attend, leave, and ask what was just said; the same scene places a stamp on hearts and preference-following behind the failure. The focus locks therefore separate exposure from understanding and compliance rather than merely excluding sound.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies material that can be heard even when it is not integrated.
Closure supplies the internal stoppage between reception and uptake.
Auditory perception supplies successful surface reception.
Understanding and compliance supply the deeper uptake conspicuously absent from mere listening.
The heart as understanding locates the failed transfer inside the same faculty named by the focus.
Stamping and imprinting supply a fixed internal pattern that resists reconfiguration by what was heard.
The inclination of desire supplies the prior orientation that receives and redirects the recitation.

structural_cues: 47:16 juxtaposes listening, immediate failure to retain the saying, stamped hearts, and following desires within one scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successful hearing, failed recall, stamping, and inclination; I infer that the lock blocks conversion of sound into understanding or compliance. The live alternative is a narrower memory failure without a general reception model.

changed_reading.before: A locked heart does not encounter the Quran.
changed_reading.after: A locked heart may hear the Quran clearly while stopping its passage from sound into retained understanding, reorientation, and obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The request for a revealed unit in 47:20 collapses when a firmly determined unit names costly action; 47:21 then contrasts acceptable speech with resolve and truthfulness. Outcome-facing reading is thus tested by whether textual reception crosses into committed follow-through.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation supply the textual reception whose practical completion is at issue.
Attention to what an affair becomes supplies the movement from command to enacted consequence.
A bounded, elevated portion supplies the discrete revealed unit first requested and then resisted.
Firmness, exactness, and secure determination supply the command's resistance to evasive reinterpretation.
Binding the heart decisively to an affair supplies the transition from agreeable speech to commitment.
Fulfilling truth in promise and action supplies the criterion by which reception becomes genuine.

structural_cues: 47:20 moves from asking for revelation to recoiling when its content becomes determinate, and 47:21 immediately moves from good speech to resolved action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies request, determinate command, recoil, resolve, and enacted truth; I infer that tadabbur must carry reading into anticipated action. A live alternative is that these verses diagnose fear of one command without redefining contemplation generally.

changed_reading.before: Tadabbur is accurate conceptual comprehension of a revealed unit.
changed_reading.after: Tadabbur follows a revealed unit far enough to accept the action it determines; agreeable speech without that consequence remains locked reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, the behind/back field becomes bodily direction: people reverse onto their backs after guidance has become clear. The root now presents a fork between looking through discourse toward what follows and using behindness as the direction of retreat.

activation_trace.role: Looking into an affair's consequence supplies the constructive, forward-projecting use of the root field.
Retrogression after prior commitment supplies explicit reversal rather than simple non-arrival.
The bodily back supplies the spatial direction into which the retreat is made.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the negative counterpart to deliberate aftermath-reading.
Manifest clarity supplies the already-open condition against which retreat must be read as refusal, not lack of evidence.

structural_cues: 47:25 follows the focus without an intervening ayah and explicitly places reversal onto backs after guidance became clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency, the repeated root, reversal, bodily backs, and prior clarity; I infer a deliberate lexical foil between two directional uses. A live alternative is that the repetition is emphatic continuity without a designed contrast in reading motion.

changed_reading.before: Tadabbur is the presence or absence of reflection.
changed_reading.after: Tadabbur and retrogression are competing orientations: one uses behindness to project toward consequences, while the other turns the reader's own back after clarity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence before the focus moves from severing kinship to blocked hearing and blinded sight, then asks about heart-locks. Closure becomes a network condition: relations and sensory channels are cut before inward integration fails.

activation_trace.role: The heart as understanding supplies the integrative center affected by upstream severance.
Closure supplies the final image for a system whose links and openings have ceased to function.
The cutting of connection supplies social disconnection rather than an isolated internal defect.
Kinship supplies the living relation whose severance precedes the lock image.
A stopped opening with no remaining gap supplies a sensory analogue of locking.
Blindness of inward insight transfers the visual failure directly into the cognitive domain.
Ordinary sight supplies the explicit channel that has been disabled before the heart is diagnosed.

structural_cues: 47:22, 47:23, and 47:24 form an uninterrupted progression from severed kinship through sensory disability to locked hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered social severance, deafness, blindness, and heart-locks; I infer a connected failure architecture. A live alternative is that these are parallel punishments whose adjacency does not imply a functional pathway.

changed_reading.before: The lock is a private mental obstruction inside an individual.
changed_reading.after: The lock is the inward endpoint of broken relational and sensory pathways, so failed reflection is simultaneously social, perceptual, and cognitive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Quran's gathering image meets a promise of obedience in only part of the matter and concealed inward speech. The lock is no longer simply open or shut; it can act as a selective gate that fragments an integrated discourse into acceptable and refused compartments.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the integrated whole that selective reception breaks apart.
Closure supplies the gate by which some relations are refused while others are admitted.
Partition into a part or segment supplies the mechanism of partial compliance.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden refusal that selective outward obedience can mask.

structural_cues: 47:26 quotes a promise to obey in some of the matter and closes by stating that the concealed speech is known.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gathered text, partial obedience, and hidden contents; I infer selective gating as the arrow connecting them. A live alternative is political duplicity limited to that scene rather than a general anatomy of the locks.

changed_reading.before: A heart either opens to the Quran or rejects it wholesale.
changed_reading.after: A heart may lock selectively, dismantling the Quran's gathered wholeness into compliant portions and sealed-off consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later diseased hearts contain what is brought out, while visible marks and the inflection of speech make their bearers recognizable. A lock can therefore conceal without making contents permanently inaccessible: inner orientation leaks into surfaces and can be diagnostically read.

activation_trace.role: Closure supplies the container whose hidden state is later inferred from what emerges around it.
The heart as inward cognition supplies the concealed interior under diagnosis.
Departure from health and balance supplies a disordered internal state rather than an empty interior.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies forced disclosure of what the heart held.
Recognition by an effect or sign supplies the diagnostic act that reads the concealed state.
A visible identifying mark supplies bodily leakage of inward orientation.
Speech slanting toward an underlying sense supplies verbal leakage from the concealed interior.

structural_cues: The branchless grudge occurrence at 47:29 word 11 and 47:37 word 6 is used only as a structural cue: hidden contents are named, brought out, and later exposed under pressure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diseased hearts, extraction from concealment, marks, and loaded speech; I infer that locked contents remain indirectly legible. A live alternative is that divine disclosure alone, not ordinary diagnostic reading, causes the visibility.

changed_reading.before: Locks make the heart a wholly opaque and empty black box.
changed_reading.after: Locks conceal a populated interior whose disorder can still be brought out or inferred from bodily signs and the direction of speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated testing at 47:31 surrounds disclosure of who strives and persists, then makes the community's inward reports knowable. Tadabbur is not exhausted by a private reading event; lived trials turn orientation into inspectable evidence.

activation_trace.role: Following an affair to its end supplies the temporal span across which reading becomes conduct.
Reading supplies the initial reception whose effects the trial later tests.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the conversion of hidden orientation into evidence.
The alternate mapped inventory independently preserves trial as disclosure, keeping the split mapping visible in the mechanism.
Uncovering a thing to the knower supplies the epistemic result of the trial.
Knowledge through report and the inside of an affair supplies the inspectable record produced by testing.

structural_cues: 47:31 repeats the testing root around knowing the strivers and the patient, then ends with testing their reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated testing, disclosure, and inward reports; I infer the arrow from Quranic reception to conduct that can verify or falsify uptake. A live alternative is that the trial measures loyalty generally without bearing on tadabbur specifically.

changed_reading.before: Tadabbur succeeds once the reader forms a coherent private interpretation.
changed_reading.after: Tadabbur remains provisional until trials let its claimed understanding appear as a reportable pattern of striving and persistence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence presses a demand, elicits miserliness, extracts hidden rancor, and calls wealth to move outward. The focus lock therefore gains a material-social realization: inward closure appears as blocked circulation, and the blockage rebounds upon the self.

activation_trace.role: Locking and the hand closed against good supply the bridge from inward closure to material withholding.
The inward self and understanding supply the source from which outward conduct should flow.
Exhaustive pressing and insistence supply pressure against the closed system.
Miserliness supplies the behavioral state in which circulation is refused.
Extraction from concealment supplies the pressure-induced exposure of the blockage's inward content.
The outward passage of wealth supplies the circulation that the locked disposition resists.
Repeated miserliness supplies the self-reinforcing refusal through which the blockage becomes visible.
The thing's own self supplies the endpoint on which withholding ultimately acts.

structural_cues: The branchless grudge occurrence at 47:37 word 6 is retained only structurally: pressure and miserliness are followed by disclosure of what was inwardly held.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, miserliness, extraction, expenditure, and recoil upon the self; I infer a circulation model linking heart-locks to withholding. A live alternative is that the economic scene exemplifies one symptom without defining the lock's wider mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A lock prevents meanings from entering the heart.
changed_reading.after: A lock can also prevent received meaning and possessed goods from leaving the self as action, so blocked outflow exposes the same inward closure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it turns a cognitive verb into bodily front-back geometry. It remains anchored in the focus root's behindness branch and the exact recurrence of backs beside faces at 47:27. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary spatial warning, not as the lexical translation of tadabbur.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 can activate what lies behind, while the post-focus sequence places bodily backs first in retreat and then opposite faces in a scene of consequence.

activation_trace.role: Behindness supplies the spatial axis on which voluntary inspection and involuntary exposure can be contrasted.
The face and forward side supply one pole of the body's complete exposure.
The back supplies the opposite pole, making consequence reach the side the reader refused to inspect.

changed_reading.before: The reader is asked to contemplate before punishment.
changed_reading.after: The reader is invited to inspect the text's behind and aftermath voluntarily before consequence renders both face and back involuntarily exposed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the heart root's concrete mold branch rather than its ordinary cognitive sense. It remains anchored in word 6 and is materially sharpened by stamped hearts at 47:16. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy for preformation, not claim that the verse calls hearts molds.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heart root at word 6 has a casting-mold branch, and the lock at word 7 can keep that fixed form from being altered by recitation.

activation_trace.role: A mold into which material is poured supplies the image of a prior form imposed on incoming discourse.
Rigidity and closure supply resistance to reshaping once the internal form is fixed.
Stamping and forming by a seal supply the contextual material process that sharpens the mold analogy.
Prior inclination supplies the shape according to which heard material is recast.

changed_reading.before: Locks simply keep the Quran outside.
changed_reading.after: A locked, imprinted heart may admit Quranic language yet cast it into a pre-existing form dictated by its inclinations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the lock root's food-hoarding branch as a cross-domain image. It remains anchored in the focus lock and collection roots and gains contextual traction from repeated miserliness and blocked expenditure at 47:38. Downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy for accumulation without release, never as the direct sense of the plural locks.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The Quran at word 3 can be a gathering, while the lock root at word 7 includes withholding a stored resource.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies accumulation of recited units and acquired knowledge.
Hoarding provisions supplies a branch-distant image of retained abundance denied circulation.
Repeated miserliness supplies the contextual conduct corresponding to hoarded reception.
Outward expenditure supplies the missing release against which hoarding is recognized.

changed_reading.before: Failure means not acquiring Quranic material.
changed_reading.after: Failure may include accumulating recitation and knowledge as a stored possession while refusing to spend their consequences into conduct.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it hears the lock root's return-from-travel branch beneath a noun whose immediate sense is plainly locks. It remains multiply anchored in focus branches for aftermath, timed arrival, return, and settled outcome, and 47:10 supplies an actual journey toward an end. Downstream prose should retain it only as a faint secondary resonance about completing an interpretive journey.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 2, 3, 6, and 7 jointly permit aftermath, appointed time, return or destination, and homecoming images alongside their ordinary senses.

activation_trace.role: The last phase and passing aftermath supply the endpoint an interpretive journey must reach.
A time that comes due or is delayed supplies the moment at which a reading's consequence arrives.
Return, destination, and final issue supply the reader's movement back with a changed orientation.
Homecoming from travel supplies the faint resonance of completing rather than merely starting the journey.
Actual passage through the land supplies the contextual journey that makes return imagery minimally coherent.
The realized end supplies what the journey must bring back into understanding.

changed_reading.before: Reading begins when one opens the text.
changed_reading.after: A completed reading returns from its journey through the text carrying the arrived consequence; closure is also failure to complete that return.

strongest_changes: 47:10 turns consequence-reading into a procedure of movement, directed observation, and comparison with realized historical ends.
47:25 makes the focus root directional: looking toward aftermath competes with turning one's own back after clarity.
47:16 separates acoustic exposure from understanding and compliance, so a lock can operate after sound has entered.
47:26 and 47:37-38 recast closure as selective gating and blocked outflow, visible in partial obedience, concealment, and withholding.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly materialized reading as direction, turning, gating, disclosure, testing, and circulation. That allowed several coexisting readings of the focus: consequence tracing, reversal toward a core, heart-specific closure, retrogression after clarity, selective reception, and accumulated meaning withheld from action.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal architecture inferred from severed kinship through deafness and blindness to heart-locks may be rhetorical adjacency rather than one mechanism.
The action and testing models may describe evidence of tadabbur rather than components of tadabbur itself.
The return, mold, and hoarding branches are visibly anchored but branch-distant; their value may remain analogical rather than lexical.
